format.title: Invoice number format
format.description: Build the format from the values below. Every invoice number must include a sequence number so it stays unique.

formatField.label: Format
formatField.hint: Anything outside {{braces}} is used as-is. Letters, digits and - / _ . are allowed.

preview.title: Next invoice numbers
preview.lengthHint_one: Up to {{count}} character (limit 100). Previewing does not use up a number.
preview.lengthHint_other: Up to {{count}} characters (limit 100). Previewing does not use up a number.

shortenHint.part4: . Values highlighted in amber make numbering non-sequential.

counter.title: Counter
counter.description: Controls the sequence number. Existing invoices are never renumbered, and a number is never reused.

never.label: Never
never.hint: One counter that keeps growing forever

startFrom.label: Start next invoice at
startFrom.hint: Only for continuing a series from another system. Moves numbering forward only.

fyStart.label: Financial year starts in
fyStart.hint: April for India and the UK, July for Australia.

sanitize.label: Clean up text values
sanitize.hint: Converts names to capitals and removes spaces, accents and punctuation — “Rahul Sharma” becomes RAHULSHARMA.
